basis: New data: E' = E (+) (cbar, cbar^*), frame Psi: S_Psi = S(A^* -> A^* - d cbar) - 1/4 int (cbar^* + d^*A|_V, cbar^* + d^*A|_V); QGF: A^* -> -2A^*, lambda^* -> -dslash lambda^*, cbar^* -> cbar^* (slot c), c^* -> -c^* (slot cbar); propagator A(x)A, lambda(x)lambda as before, c(x)cbar = -(-,-)^{-1}, cbar(x)c = +(-,-)^{-1} times e^{-eps|p|^2}/|p|^2 (checks C_propagator).

Pullback theorem (checks C_frames): j = p o Phi : (E', Q_Psi) -> (E, Q), j(c,A,lambda,cbar,c^*,A^*,lambda^*,cbar^*) = (c,A,lambda,c^*,A^*-d cbar,lambda^*), is a chain map with (j x j)K_t = K_t and (j x j)P_Psi(eps,T) = P_former(eps,T); I_Psi = I o j. Hence for every functional J of the minimal fields W(P_Psi, J o j) = W(P_former, J) o j graph by graph, the counterterms are I^CT o j, the QME defect is the former defect o j, Delta_eps and {,}_eps commute with o j.

Equivariant data: S^(1)_Psi(x) = S^(1)(x) o j + S^(1)_nm(x) o Phi with S^(1)_nm(v) = -(v.cbar, cbar^*) (v conformal Killing, cbar of Weyl weight 2), S^(1)_nm = 0 on Sigma, Sigma^*, so(W); S^(2)_Psi(x1,x2) = S^(2)(x1,x2) o j - int (cbar, Gamma(eps1,eps2)|_V (cbar)) (checks E).

Consequently: (a) everything at arity zero is a pullback; (b) arity one along xi in Sigma, eta in Sigma^* and along so(W_R^perp) is a pullback (identical graphs, the former composite lambda-c lines are the lambda-cbar vertex lines of frame Psi); (c) arity one along Delta, P_b, so(V), K_b changes by the vertex -(v.cbar, cbar^* + d^*A|_V), which cancels the composite A|_V-c lines exactly for Delta, P_b, so(V) and leaves the local vertex 4 int (cbar, iota_b A|_V) along K_b; (d) arity two changes along every pair whose bracket has a nonzero V-part (new cbar cbar vertex, new S^(1)_nm of the bracket); (e) the twisted theory along a square-zero xi (Gamma(xi,xi) = 0) is a pullback.

gauge_parameter_independence.statement: Family alpha = -1/2 + u of the reduced pair: S_u = S_Psi + u G, G = 1/2 int (cbar^* + d^*A|_V, cbar^* + d^*A|_V). G = -s( int (cbar^* + d^*A|_V, cbar) ), s = Q_Psi + {I_Psi, -} (exact, classical; Lemma c4-count applied to the cbar count). With u treated as a formal parameter (u G quadratic, kept in the interaction so that Q, QGF, H stay those of u = 0), the u-derivative of a family of one-loop quantisations is s-closed and its class lies in C(S - S^(2)) + C G_B + Im s; hence the spectrum of Lambda^(1)(Delta) on cohomology and the classes [Q^xi_1] are u-independent (Theorems c8-invariants (iii), c8-twist).
gauge_parameter_independence.gauge_parameter_in_axioms: H = [Q, QGF] = |p|^2 with QGF of order <= 1 forces alpha = -1/2 (checks B: (QGF)^2 proportional to (2 alpha + 1)^2); other alpha lie outside [C07, Def 4.3.3] and enter only as the formal deformation u G.
gauge_parameter_independence.gauge_fermion_shape: Psi -> Psi + u Psi_1 (Psi_1 local of degree -1 in cbar) changes S_Psi by u{S_Psi, Psi_1} + O(u^2): BV-exact, same conclusion.
